comments.quote: Very friendly owner. Comfortable room. We had a nice hike to Moganshan international Scenic Area. HouWu village is only 7 minutes DiDi away from the guesthouse, with good selection of restaurants and other places of interest. Breakfast is Chinese, but...
comments.author: Misha Shayter

comments.quote: The loft room is simply amazing. The children are very happy. The swimming pool is their favorite. The overall hygiene is good, but the bathroom and sink are a bit too small.
comments.author: Guest User

comments.quote: Нам все понравилось. Было 5 человек. Номер в 2 этажа. На первом 2 комнаты и туалет и на втором одна большая комната, трасса и туалет! Завтрак в национальной традиции. Нам понравились булочки. На рецепшене вкусное пиво!)
comments.author: Мария Велик
